Entropy Computer

2021
Site-specific installation, mixed media
Akademie Schloss Solitude

Entropy Computer is a site-specific installation that turned Akademie Schloss Solitude into a functioning computer. The building’s windows acted as display outputs while it computed environmental data: the movement of clouds and the sounds of nearby insects. These unpredictable inputs were used as entropy to generate random bits for encryption. The project explores autonomy in digital systems by sourcing randomness from the natural world instead of centralized hardware.
